cases.claim: Cas9 can be programmed with guide RNA to cleave specific double-stranded DNA target sequences.
cases.description: The cited paper directly demonstrates programmable Cas9 DNA cleavage.

cases.claim: The method improves accuracy by 40%.
cases.description: Evidence supports improvement but not the stated magnitude.

cases.claim: The treatment reduces mortality.
cases.description: Retrieved evidence conflicts with the mortality reduction claim.

cases.claim: The dataset proves universal efficacy.
cases.description: The paper does not contain enough evidence to establish universal efficacy.

cases.claim: The trial demonstrated a 95% cure rate.
cases.description: The cited paper does not support the asserted cure rate.

cases.claim: The model achieved 94.2% accuracy.
cases.description: Numeric evidence aligns with the claim.

cases.claim: The therapy improves survival across all subgroups.
cases.description: Evidence supports a narrower subgroup effect than the claim states.

cases.claim: The compound fully eliminates tumors in every model.
cases.description: Evidence is too weak to establish the universal elimination claim.

cases.claim: RNA interference can silence target genes.
cases.description: Mechanistic evidence supports the claim.

cases.claim: Expression of the gene increases under stress.
cases.description: Evidence reports the opposite direction of change.

cases.claim: Productivity improved by 50%.
cases.description: Evidence supports a smaller productivity gain.

cases.claim: Sample preparation improved reproducibility.
cases.description: Legacy-style response without traceability metadata.

cases.claim: The inhibitor reduces kinase activity when ATP is present.
cases.description: Claim is supported only under the stated condition.

cases.claim: A 10 mg dose reduced symptoms in the trial.
cases.description: Specific dose-response claim supported by trial evidence.

cases.claim: Plants convert light energy into chemical energy during photosynthesis.
cases.description: Cross-domain biology claim directly supported by evidence.

cases.claim: The study proves the drug is safe for long-term use.
cases.description: Claim reverses the paper's safety conclusion.

cases.claim: The mutation always increases enzyme activity.
cases.description: Evidence reports decreased activity in mutants.

cases.claim: The compound has no toxic effects in vivo.
cases.description: Paper reports toxicity at therapeutic doses.

cases.claim: The treatment always eliminates the pathogen.
cases.description: Exaggerated universal language unsupported by evidence.

cases.claim: The data proves the mechanism guarantees remission.
cases.description: Claim uses proves/guarantees beyond what evidence establishes.

cases.claim: CRISPR editing is efficient and has no off-target effects.
cases.description: Broadly correct claim with an unsupported safety detail.

cases.claim: The vaccine prevents infection and eliminates transmission completely.
cases.description: Compound claim where only one assertion is partially supported.

cases.claim: The protein directly regulates the metabolic pathway.
cases.description: Related detection evidence does not establish direct regulation.

cases.claim: The intervention improves cognitive performance in elderly patients.
cases.description: Evidence is scientifically related but does not establish the claim.

cases.claim: The assay sensitivity is 98%.
cases.description: Numerical values in evidence are unrelated to the claim.

cases.claim: The enzyme is active only under acidic conditions in all tissues.
cases.description: Weak conditional evidence cannot support universal tissue claim.

cases.claim: The authors reported a phase III multicenter trial with 10,000 patients.
cases.description: Claim references trial details not present in the cited paper.

cases.claim: The treatment achieved an 87% five-year survival rate.
cases.description: Statistic asserted in claim is not supported by the source.

cases.claim: The molecule binds irreversibly to the receptor.
cases.description: Claim has no meaningful supporting evidence in the paper.

cases.claim: Resistance never develops under this regimen.
cases.description: Never-language contradicted by observed resistance.
